# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update. The bundled renderer includes current upstream fixes. Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should verify text output after upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer with the latest upstream fixes. On Linux, font fallback now tries FcFontMatch before FcFontSort, which can select a different fallback face; specify a family and style or bundle a typeface when exact metrics and glyphs matter. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.
